Protection for a Lifetime of Wear

Our products are built to last a lifetime but accidents and natural incidences are a part of daily life. The "Premium Protection Plan" is a one time purchase that offers both a lifetime of protection and a lifetime peace of mind for your handmade piece.

What's Included

The Premium Protection Plan is a "No Questions Asked" plan that covers anything from refinishes, to resizes, to repairs1. The following are examples of what is covered for free under the Premium Protection Plan:

  • Cleanings
  • Inspections
  • Ring Resizing (within what is physically possible and replacement where appropriate)
  • Repair of damage from any circumstance
  • Refinishes
  • Polishing
  • Re-etching of Meteorite, Damascus, and other etched metals
  • Re-anodizing of Timascus, Zircuti, and other anodized metals
  • Re-darkening of Meteorite
  • Re-engraving or adding future engraving
  • Earring back and post repair
  • Chain and clasp repair

1See Premium Protection Plan Terms & Conditions Page for more information.

Comparison

At Patrick Adair Designs, all products come with a Limited Lifetime Warranty by default. This warranty covers a variety of low probability potential issues that occur not as a result of natural wear and tear over time.

We recommend adding the Premium Protection plan to cover repair and maintenance of your piece that occurs as a result of day-to-day wear and tear.

Comparison

The price of our Premium Protection Plan is calculated based on the cost of your handmade jewelry piece and can be added on directly through the product listing itself.

Consider the Savings

Over the lifetime of owning a piece of jewelry, the costs for repairing, resizing, and refinishing can quickly add up. Simple wear and tear from normal day-to-day activities can dull and cause damage to your handmade piece. Our Premium Protection Plan will put your mind at ease if something does happen to your jewelry.

Protecting a Recent Purchase

If you would like to protect your recent purchase with the Premium Protection Plan, please contact us via email at support@patrickadairdesigns.com with your order #.

How To File a Claim

If you have purchased the Premium Protection Plan for your handmade piece and need to file a claim, please email us at support@patrickadairdesigns.com using the email you used to place the order. Please include the following information:

  • Your Order #
  • Description of Damage and How it Occurred
  • Relevant Video and/or Photos of Damage

Your claim will be processed and responded to within 48 hours. A Customer Support Specialist will contact you with a return label and a course of action and timeframe for a repair/replacement.
